title: On the robustness of Quantum Phase Estimation to compute ground properties of many-electron systems
summary: We propose an analysis of the Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE) algorithm applied to many-electron systems by investigating its free parameters such as the time step, number of phase qubits, initial state preparation, number of measurement shots, and other parameters related to the unitary operators implementation. A deep understanding of these parameters and their impact on QPE probability of success and precision of the results is important to pave the way towards more automation of QPE applied to predictive computational chemistry and material science.
